title: Runway Briefing: Missile Strike Shuts Down Riyadh, Ukraine's Drone War Grounds Russian Airports, and American Finally Fixes Its Delay Lies
summary: A Houthi missile slips past Saudi defenses and hits a fuel depot at Riyadh's main airport, and it's part of a bigger pattern of war zones rewriting flight maps. Plus, US airlines fight to keep China's carriers grounded, American finally admits rolling delays are a scam, and a fuel truck at JFK does some very expensive damage to an Air China 747.
